title: Etale schemes over a field and continuous G-sets
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K^sep a separable closure, and G=Gal(K^sep/K) with its Krull topology. The functor X \mapsto Hom_K(Spec K^sep,X) is an equivalence from the category of etale K-schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism] to the category of discrete continuous G-sets. Under this equivalence, etale coverings correspond to jointly surjective families of G-equivariant maps.
